item.description: The _quotep3 function has a bug where it attempts to call .decode() on a string object, causing AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'decode'
item.contract: The _quotep3 function should properly handle both bytes and string inputs when performing URL encoding operations. The function should not attempt to call .decode() on a string that's already decoded.

item.description: The _quotep3b function has the same bug as _quotep3 where it attempts to call .decode() on a string object
item.contract: The _quotep3b function should properly handle both bytes and string inputs when performing URL encoding operations. The function should not attempt to call .decode() on a string that's already decoded.

item.description: The _quotep2 function has a similar issue where it calls w8dec on a result that may already be a string
item.contract: The _quotep2 function should properly handle both bytes and string inputs when performing URL encoding operations.

item.description: JSON decoding error in test_dk_fk due to malformed JSON response from the server
item.contract: The server should return valid JSON responses for API calls, particularly when handling directory keys and file keys.

item.description: HTTP status code assertion failure where server returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of expected 422 Unprocessable Entity
item.contract: The server should properly validate duplicate file uploads and return appropriate HTTP status codes (422 Unprocessable Entity) for validation errors.
